records.name: Veronica Garcia
records.notes: Dr. Veronica Garcia began as president of Northeast Lakeview College (Alamo Colleges District) on March 1, 2017; she has over 30 years in higher education (Ph.D., Oregon State University). Her immediate prior title/institution is not stated on the college's bio page, and no named predecessor could be confirmed via the college's own site or available news archives -- NLC is a relatively young college (opened 2008) and detailed leadership-history pages were not found.

records.name: Marcia J. Ballinger
records.notes: Marcia J. Ballinger became LCCC's president in July 2016 (the LCCC student paper called her the college's '6th president'); she is LCCC's first female president and was promoted from within the college's administration.

records.name: Roy A. Church
records.notes: Dr. Roy Church led LCCC for nearly three decades (1987-2016), announcing his retirement in October 2015 effective June 30, 2016, after 45 years in higher education.

records.name: Richard R. Mellott
records.notes: Served as interim president between Omar Olson and Roy Church.

records.name: Omar L. Olson
records.notes: LCCC's second president; the college's first president was Max J. Lerner (1963-1970), with Thomas Bowen serving as acting president 1970-1971.

records.name: Vinicio J. Lopez
records.notes: Dr. Vinicio J. Lopez was named the 9th president of Evergreen Valley College (San Jose-Evergreen CCD) and began September 16, 2024, after nearly 25 years as a community college faculty member/administrator, most recently VP of Instruction at Skyline College (2022-2024).

records.name: Denise Noldon
records.notes: Denise Noldon served as Acting/Interim President of Evergreen Valley College prior to Lopez's appointment; exact start date of her interim term not precisely confirmed in available sources. She previously held roles at Los Angeles Valley College, Contra Costa College, Chabot College, and Los Angeles Southwest College.

records.name: Rebecca (Becky) Opsata
records.notes: Dr. Becky Opsata assumed the role of Acting President of Laney College (Peralta CCD) effective March 19, 2025, initially through June 30, 2025; Board of Trustees reports as recent as April 2026 still refer to her as 'Interim President,' so her status has not converted to permanent as of the latest confirmed reporting.

records.name: Rudy Besikof
records.notes: Dr. Rudy Besikof transitioned out of the Laney College presidency on March 19, 2025, after having been promoted internally from VP of Instruction; his exact start year as president was not confirmed in available sources (Peralta Citizen coverage of his departure was inaccessible for verification).

seats.university: City Colleges of Chicago-Malcolm X College

records.name: David A. Sanders
records.notes: David Sanders served as Interim President of Malcolm X College beginning July 2015 (overseeing the move into the new $251M building he had also managed construction of as CCC Deputy COO) and was subsequently confirmed as permanent President by the CCC Board of Trustees.

records.name: Zerrie D. Campbell
records.notes: Dr. Zerrie D. Campbell became president of Malcolm X College by 1992, the first woman to hold the post; her exact end date and any intervening presidents between her tenure and Sanders' 2015 appointment could not be confirmed with available sources this session.

records.name: Kellie Sims Butler
records.notes: Kellie Sims Butler is confirmed as Solano Community College's current Superintendent-President via Wikipedia; the college's own presidential bio/history pages returned errors during this research session, so her exact start date, prior role, and named predecessor could not be independently verified. Flagging this as a confirmed-current/unconfirmed-history gap.

records.name: Victoria L. Bastecki-Perez
records.notes: Dr. Victoria L. Bastecki-Perez was named the sixth President of Montgomery County Community College (PA) in May 2020. The college's own president/leadership pages returned 404 errors during this session (and a same-named 'mccc.edu' domain resolves to the unrelated Mercer County Community College, NJ), so her prior title/institution and the name of the fifth president could not be independently confirmed this session despite genuine effort.

records.name: Jamelle J. Conner
records.notes: Dr. Jamelle J. Conner became the 15th president of Amarillo College in January 2025 -- the college's first female president. She spent 17 years at St. Petersburg College (FL), most recently as VP of Student Affairs. The college's site does not name her immediate predecessor; news accounts (unconfirmed this session) suggest the seat had been held by Russell Lowery-Hart before he departed to lead the Tarrant County College District, but this could not be verified via a fetchable source this session.

records.name: Matthew Jordan
records.notes: Matthew Jordan is confirmed as West LA College's current president via Wikipedia. The college's official site (wlac.edu) returned a 403/blocked response during this research session, preventing confirmation of his start date, prior role, or named predecessor within the Los Angeles Community College District.

records.name: Keith Brown
records.notes: Keith Brown served as interim president from 2014-2018 following Judy Merritt's long tenure, then was made permanent president in 2018.

records.name: Judy M. Merritt
records.notes: 35-year president, one of the longest tenures of any community college president nationally.

records.name: George L. Layton
records.notes: Second president of the college.

records.name: Leroy Brown
records.notes: Founding president of Jefferson State Community College.

records.name: Michael S. Brophy
records.notes: Dr. Michael Brophy became HVCC's 8th president on August 1, 2025. He previously served roughly 20 years combined as president of three institutions: Hilbert College (Buffalo), Marymount California University, and Benedictine University (Chicago); earlier in his career he held enrollment-management roles at The College of Saint Rose, Russell Sage College, SUNY Canton, and in the University of Wisconsin two-year college system.

records.name: Louis Coplin
records.notes: Louis Coplin, recently retired VP of Student Affairs, was named interim president by the board after Roger Ramsammy's termination on June 25, 2024, serving until Brophy's arrival in August 2025.

records.name: Roger A. Ramsammy
records.notes: Ramsammy was terminated on June 25, 2024 for sexual harassment, per Wikipedia's sourced account.

records.name: Andrew J. Matonak
records.notes: Preceded by Marco J. Silvestri (interim, 2004-2005) and John L. Buono (1998-2003).

records.name: Gregory (Greg) Little
records.notes: Greg Little is confirmed as Midlands Technical College's current president via the college's own site, which frames him as a recently-arrived president ('As I begin as President of Midlands Technical College...'), but does not state an exact start date, his prior title/institution, or his predecessor's name on the pages reachable this session. The college's site does reference a 'Presidents Emeriti' section, indicating a documented succession exists, but that page could not be retrieved (redirect loop).

seats.university: John C Calhoun State Community College

records.name: Jimmy Hodges
records.notes: Dr. Jimmy Hodges is confirmed as Calhoun Community College's current president via Wikipedia and the college's own About page (calhoun.edu/about/). Neither source reachable this session provided his start date, prior role, or predecessor's name; a dedicated President's Office bio page was not found (404).

records.name: Janet N. Spriggs
records.notes: Dr. Janet N. Spriggs is confirmed as Forsyth Tech's current President & CEO via the college's own leadership page. Her exact start date, prior title/institution, and named predecessor were not confirmable via sources reachable this session -- Wikipedia's history section only references a much earlier president, Dr. Bob H. Greene (d. 2011), not a direct predecessor to Spriggs.

records.name: Robin Satterwhite
records.notes: Dr. Robin Satterwhite is confirmed as South Plains College's current president via the college's own President's Welcome page; she is herself an SPC graduate. Her exact start date, prior title, and her predecessor's name were not stated on the reachable page and could not be independently confirmed this session.

records.name: Frank Nigro
records.notes: Frank Nigro is confirmed as Shasta College's current president via Wikipedia's infobox. The college's own President's Office page returned a 404 during this session, so his start date, prior role, and predecessor could not be independently confirmed despite attempts.

records.name: Charles S. Sasaki
records.notes: Charles S. Sasaki was appointed Ohlone College's 8th president in 2023. The college's own site (ohlone.edu) was blocked (403) during this session, so his prior title/institution could not be independently confirmed.

records.name: Eric Bishop
records.notes: Eric Bishop was selected as Ohlone's 7th president in 2020 per The Mercury News (April 14, 2020), preceding Sasaki.

records.name: Vince Rodriguez
records.notes: Dr. Vince Rodriguez became Coastline College president in July 2021, promoted from within after 23+ years at the college in roles including Director/Dean of Distance Learning and VP of Instruction. His named predecessor could not be confirmed via the reachable page this session.
